description: START HERE for 'how many calls or credits do I have left'. COST: free, no API key required, and it does not count against the keyless 10 calls per day (it is subject to the per-minute pace limit like every call). Returns your tier (keyless, free, starter, pro, enterprise or agent), calls used and remaining for the current window (daily for keyless, monthly for plans), credits remaining for agent keys, when the window resets (resets_at), and your per-minute pace limit. Never charges anything.
name: get_usage
title: Get my usage and limits
